specs.name: cathedral
specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual environment background for a high-detail 2D side scrolling gothic exploration game. Create a wide 1536x1024 full-bleed landscape background painting: an enormous ruined gothic cathedral cloister, midnight blue moonlight through left open pointed arches revealing a distant spired castle over waterfalls, on the right tall exquisite red and sapphire stained glass of a sorrowful saint, weathered charcoal stone tracery and buttresses, old brass candles and burgundy banners. Eye-level orthographic SIDE VIEW, not isometric. Deep layered atmospheric architecture. Dense jewel-like hand painted digital pixel art, fine 1-pixel texture detail, intricate material shading and sharp details, cinematic quality, NOT chunky retro low-resolution blocks. Most of the lower 25 percent is dim recesses beneath architecture; clear open area for separately rendered gameplay. No characters, creatures, weapons, HUD, text, logos, interface, foreground silhouettes, or foreground walkable platforms. Background environment art only, richly detailed and legible, luminous mist and subtle warm highlights.

specs.name: hero
specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D side-scrolling CHARACTER ANIMATION SPRITE ATLAS with real alpha transparency. Wide 1536x1024 canvas, EXACTLY 4 columns x 3 rows evenly spaced identical 384x341 cells, 12 full-body poses of the SAME original gothic male hunter, always facing RIGHT in side / three-quarter-side view. Long black windswept hair, pale face, fitted black brocade coat with antique gold trim and crimson inner tails, leather trousers, knee high boots, silver whip handle in right hand. Dense exquisite high-resolution hand-painted pixel-art with fine highlights and realistic anatomy, not chunky or chibi. Body height about 260 pixels in every cell. All feet on same baseline 305 pixels within each cell, body centered at x=192, all limbs contained within their cell, ample clear transparent gutter. Row 1: four running animation keyframes, clearly alternating leading leg, dynamic cloak. Row 2: idle ready pose, second breathing idle, rising jump with bent legs, descending jump with coat flying. Row 3: attack windup with arm back, forward whip strike arm extended (handle only no long whip), followthrough sweeping arm, low evasive dash. No ground, shadows, labels, grid lines, text, background, overlapping poses. A consistent finely illustrated hero in twelve expressive animation frames.

specs.name: belfry
specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 1536x1024 wide landscape background for a refined gothic side-scrolling game. Interior of an impossibly tall ruined cathedral BELL TOWER at midnight. Eye-level side view, straight-on architecture. Enormous ancient brass bells hanging from oak beams, multiple interlocking vast clockwork wheels in background, many weathered stone pointed arches, long thick ropes, a broken circular clock face opening to lavender moonlight and a distant spired skyline. Carefully hand-drawn dense high-resolution pixel-art detail, tiny material highlights, cinematic teal and amber light, beautiful painterly atmosphere, no chunky low-resolution blocks, not isometric. Tall architecture fills top 70%, dark vertical structural recesses and arches in bottom 30%. Distinct from a church nave, intricate engineering of bells, gears and clock. No characters, enemies, UI, text, logos, foreground walkable platforms or floor. Environment only, playable layers added separately.
